review.reviewer: Codex recover_delivery source research agent; not independent production acceptance
review.brief_mismatch: Empty, smooth rigid-looking bag; reusable fabric, flexible sides and purchased items are not demonstrated.
review.semantic_recommendation: Consider a separately documented plain open retail-bag brief for the already-approved broad purchased-goods-carrier definition. Fabric and visible contents are not semantically necessary. Paired loop handles and a tall solid body are distinct from the accepted squat slotted basket at simulated minimum size.
review.gift_bag_limit: No bow, tag, tissue or branding makes the source specifically gift-oriented. A generic empty carrier cannot prove intended shopping use absolutely.
